alt: Murchison Tower at Trinity University in San Antonio — a tall Gothic stone bell tower on the campus skyline.
story: Trinity University unveiled a new sunburst logo on July 30, 2026, replacing the iconic 166-foot Murchison Tower — then paused the entire rollout within five days after alumni flooded social media saying it looked like every hotel and bank logo ever made.
why_funny: After consulting over 300 people for nearly a year, they produced something so generic that the university itself had to hit pause before anyone even ordered new stationery.
